objective: Factor Windows execution identity and payload privilege into orthogonal LEGO dimensions, preserve backward compatibility, prove active_user+elevated as a fail-closed provider capability, then use it to unblock Gateway Windows public cutover.

targetModel.brokerAuthority: provider-internal privileged transport, not caller-facing payload authority

invariants: Gateway does not gain Runtime execution truth.
Privileged Broker remains the only LocalSystem token-acquisition/launch seam.
active_user+elevated must bind the same admission-frozen user SID and session as active_user.
An elevated linked token must prove High-or-higher integrity and enabled Administrators membership.
If the interactive user has no suitable linked elevated token, admission or dispatch fails closed.
No UAC prompt is synthesized and no credential/password collection is added.
Legacy windowsAuthority values preserve exact historical semantics and replay identity.
Immutable-input Windows admission remains limited-only until separately proven.
No bearer bytes or user token handles enter durable Job state.
